def cost(W, J, n, v):
    return W[v, n] + J[n]

def compute_J(G, dest_node):
    N = G.number_of_nodes()
    # step 1. start with zeros
    i = 0
    Ji = np.zeros(N)

    next_J = np.zeros(N)

    W = nx.to_numpy_array(G)

    done = False
    while not done:
        i += 1
        for v in range(N):
            if v == dest_node:
                next_J[v] = 0
                continue
            F_v = list(G.neighbors(v))
            costs = [cost(W, Ji, n, v) for n in F_v]
            next_J[v] = min(costs)
        done = np.allclose(next_J, Ji)
        Ji = next_J.copy()
    return Ji
